definitions.explanation: Requiring immediate attention or action. Used primarily in formal writing and official statements to emphasize the urgency of a matter.

examples.japanese: {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Countermeasures for the declining birthrate are a pressing issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{早急|そうきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Global warming is a pressing issue for the international community, and each country needs to take action promptly.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-language word. Almost always appears in the pattern {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun, modifying words like ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧ (issue), ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (problem), or ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧ (situation). Common in government statements, news reports, and policy documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧: urgent issue/task
- {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: pressing problem
- {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧: urgent situation
- {喫緊|きっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{必要性|ひつようせい}→必要性：04821_hitsuyousei⟧: pressing necessity

SIMILAR WORDS:
{喫緊|きっきん} is the most formal. ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧ (urgent, emergency) is also formal but used more broadly, including spoken language. ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要|よう}する→要する：14342_yousuru⟧ (requiring urgency) is another formal alternative.
